summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of CRM Integration Settings Panel in Import Modal. All 10 features tested and working correctly.
test_credentials: None required - all tests use mock_mode=true
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_DealerSocket Integration for testing (deleted after tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRM Integration Settings Panel fully tested in Import Modal. All features working: 1) CRM tab appears alongside Quick Import, URL/Sheet, Sources tabs, 2) Health Summary shows Healthy/Degraded/Unhealthy/Mock counts correctly, 3) Add CRM Integration button opens form, 4) CRM Type dropdown lists all 8 adapters (7 CRMs + generic_rest), 5) Create integration with mock mode works with success toast, 6) Test Connection button works and shows success toast, 7) Sync button works and shows records synced toast with duration, 8) Toggle Mock mode button works and updates UI, 9) Delete integration with confirmation works, 10) Header shows Integration Health Status with MOCK badge

crm_tab_in_import_modal.details: CRM tab appears in Import Modal alongside Quick Import, URL/Sheet, Sources tabs

health_summary.details: Health Summary shows Healthy/Degraded/Unhealthy/Mock counts correctly with color-coded boxes

add_integration_button.details: Add CRM Integration button opens form with CRM Type dropdown, Display Name input, API Key input, Customers/Vehicles toggle, Mock Mode toggle, and Create button

crm_type_dropdown.details: CRM Type dropdown lists all 8 adapters: CDK, DealerSocket, DealerTrack, Reynolds, VinSolutions, elead, ProMax, and generic_rest

create_integration_mock_mode.details: Created TEST_DealerSocket Integration with mock mode enabled. Toast showed 'Integration created! Mock mode enabled for testing'

test_connection_button.details: Test Connection button works. Toast showed 'Connection successful! Mock mode enabled'

sync_button.details: Sync button works. Toast showed 'Synced 50 records - Completed in 104ms'. Last sync timestamp updated on integration card

toggle_mock_mode.details: Toggle Mock mode button works. Toast showed 'Mock mode disabled'. MOCK badge removed from integration card

delete_integration.details: Delete integration with confirmation dialog works. Toast showed 'Integration deleted'. Integration removed from list

header_integration_health_status.details: Header shows Integration Health Status component with '1/1 CRM' and MOCK badge when integrations are in mock mode

mocked_apis_note: CRM integrations use mock_mode which returns simulated data from the backend. This is intentional per user request - when real CRM credentials are introduced, mock_mode can be set to false.
